title: Kirby Problem 4.22
exact_target: Can every topological Wall surgery-group action for a good fundamental group be realized smoothly without stabilization? Include the product, lens-space-product, and nonsplittable real-projective-space cases.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2898 (KP-4.22). CC BY 4.0.
